title: The balanced tripartitioning tensor P₃ has border rank at least 150
statement: Let P₃ = T_{3,3,3} = Σ x_S y_T z_U over all ordered partitions (S, T, U) of [9] into 3-sets, an 84 × 84 × 84 tensor. Project its first factor by the explicit 9 × 84 integer matrix Φ with entries −1, 0, 1 printed in the README and take the Koszul–Young flattening with p = 4: M = K₄((Φ ⊗ 1 ⊗ 1)P₃) is a 10 584 × 10 584 integer matrix whose rank is 10 498 modulo 2 and 10 500 modulo every odd prime q ≤ 31. Since 10 498 > 10 430 = 149 · C(8, 4), the border rank of P₃ is at least 150 over ℂ and over every field of characteristic 0 or of prime characteristic q ≤ 31. With the upper bound R(P₃) ≤ 247 of Flavi, Jelisiejew and Michałek (Proposition 6.18; over every field of characteristic ≠ 2 by the partial-Fourier note), 150 ≤ border rank(P₃) ≤ R(P₃) ≤ 247 over ℂ and in characteristic 0 or 3 ≤ q ≤ 31. The previous lower bound found in the literature is the flattening bound 84.
